question: For well MW3, what is the difference in depth to water (in feet) between the earliest monitoring date and the latest monitoring date recorded in the monitoring data summary?
conclusion: For pilot16, replacing the missing native text on gold pages 10 and 11 with deterministic Tesseract OCR text changes BM25 from zero-signal retrieval to ranking both evidence pages in the top two.
causal_interpretation: The observed retrieval failure is attributable to missing page text representation rather than an inability of the frozen BM25 scorer to rank the question-relevant OCR terms.
scope_limitation: This is an Oracle-OCR ablation because benchmark labels identified pages 10 and 11 before OCR. It demonstrates representation recoverability but does not solve label-free page discovery for a fully scanned 37-page document.
